description: This PHP source file defines the 'Archive' class within the 'ZipStream\Option' namespace, providing configuration options for ZIP archive creation, including compression settings, HTTP headers, and stream handling.

classes.name: Archive
classes.description: A class encapsulating configuration options for ZIP archive creation, such as compression level, large file handling, HTTP headers, and stream output settings.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Returns the ZIP archive comment string.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Sets the ZIP archive comment string.

methods.name: getLargeFileSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum size of files to load into memory.

methods.name: setLargeFileSize
methods.description: Sets the maximum size of files to load into memory.

methods.name: getLargeFileMethod
methods.description: Returns the method used for handling large files.

methods.name: setLargeFileMethod
methods.description: Sets the method used for handling large files.

methods.name: isSendHttpHeaders
methods.description: Checks if HTTP headers should be sent.

methods.name: setSendHttpHeaders
methods.description: Enables or disables sending HTTP headers.

methods.name: getHttpHeaderCallback
methods.description: Returns the callback used to send HTTP headers.

methods.name: setHttpHeaderCallback
methods.description: Sets the callback used to send HTTP headers.

methods.name: isEnableZip64
methods.description: Checks if Zip64 extension is enabled.

methods.name: setEnableZip64
methods.description: Enables or disables Zip64 extension.

methods.name: isZeroHeader
methods.description: Checks if zero header streaming is enabled.

methods.name: setZeroHeader
methods.description: Enables or disables zero header streaming.

methods.name: isFlushOutput
methods.description: Checks if output stream flushing is enabled.

methods.name: setFlushOutput
methods.description: Enables or disables output stream flushing.

methods.name: isStatFiles
methods.description: Checks if file stat reading is enabled.

methods.name: setStatFiles
methods.description: Enables or disables reading file stat for size determination.

methods.name: getContentDisposition
methods.description: Returns the Content-Disposition header value.

methods.name: setContentDisposition
methods.description: Sets the Content-Disposition header value.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Returns the Content-Type header value.

methods.name: setContentType
methods.description: Sets the Content-Type header value.

methods.name: getOutputStream
methods.description: Returns the output stream resource or object.

methods.name: setOutputStream
methods.description: Sets the output stream resource or object.

methods.name: getDeflateLevel
methods.description: Returns the deflate compression level.

methods.name: setDeflateLevel
methods.description: Sets the deflate compression level.
